trigger: pool-acquire timeout, statement timeout or query error under a plain DEX observation read (Health, Overview, Trends, family drill)
classification_rationale: D5 and V11 stated as a fixed direction what 25 of 27 DEX store reads do not do today (#2659); neither a residual nor a scope limit was recorded
summary: D5/V11 said a failed read gives an error, never an empty or perfect result. Shipped DEX observation reads return empty on a degraded store and the composite then reads 100; only the per-device score and the catalogue fail closed. Reported independently by sre, security-guardian, architect, consistency-auditor, happy-path and unhappy-path.

trigger: most in-scope devices unheard (boot-looping model, off-network laptops, size-capped syncs, crash reporting off, observer disabled): e.g. 11 of 400 report
classification_rationale: D5 'unknown, never healthy' and the population count cover zero and sub-floor, not partial, stale or survivor coverage; residuals named two causes of a wider class
summary: Rates and scores over survivors with '11 reporting' shown leave 389 devices invisible, so a model that kills its devices can rank best; denominators are connected-now counts. sre (observer-disabled devices count as no-crash) and enterprise-readiness (promise outruns residuals) reported the same class.

trigger: D9 implemented on a default install: GuaranteedState:Read is held by any authenticated session with access control off and by most built-in roles when on, against an administrator-only forensic tier today
classification_rationale: D9 supersedes the authorization model and permission documents for aggregates but amends/restate lists named only capability-map 32.7 and the risk row said only 'more operators'
summary: The reader population and the superseded statement were not named; an upgrade note is owed when it ships. Also raised by enterprise-readiness (upgrade note, assurance re-verification) and security-guardian (carry-forward).

trigger: a DEX-permission reader subtracts fleet total minus visible cohorts, or parent group minus child group, over additive usage sums that each pass a per-figure floor
classification_rationale: D9's mitigation 'only aggregates above the floor move' fails for additive figures; the implementing PR would derive I1 with E2 if built as worded
summary: For usage the floor is the only barrier between a DEX-permission reader and per-device usage that sits behind scoped Forensics:Read, the RBAC-off administrator floor and a fail-closed audit.

trigger: an Operator (GuaranteedState:Read plus Tag:Write) tags the target and nine decoys as cohort A and a known-idle device plus the same nine as cohort B, then reads summed usage by cohort: A minus B is the target's usage
classification_rationale: D8/D9 allow usage aggregates by cohort at the DEX permission with only a device-count floor; cohorts are reader-redefinable, so per-device usage is recoverable with no forensic grant and no audit row
summary: Floor counts devices only; cohort routes take any key and value; aggregates are not audited. E2 arguable (recovering per-device usage without the forensic grant). security-guardian to rule on E2 at the re-review.

trigger: an implementing PR copies the flat aggregate gate onto an identified drill or onto usage by group, or ships an aggregate that a confined operator reads unfiltered
classification_rationale: D9/D11 settle cross-cutting read policy ('same permission, same floor') without distinguishing aggregates from reads that name devices, and say nothing on confined operators or service-scoped tokens; V5 read literally floors the identified drill
summary: Existing DEX reads fall in three classes (flat aggregates, identified drills with fail-closed audit and no floor, the audited compare). Also raised by consistency-auditor (floor versus the observation list), security-guardian (carry-forward) and unhappy-path (confined and service-scoped callers, I1/E2 if unguarded).

trigger: a hub drill-down on a point older than the raw window, or a read capped at the store limit
classification_rationale: D3/V1 say any figure can be recomputed from its observations, but raw observations expire at thirty days by default, later periods rest on summaries that do not exist yet, and reads are capped
summary: Also raised by compliance-officer (internal conflict with the retention residual), consistency-auditor (below-floor count versus an observation list), docs-writer (series are not observations) and happy-path (B2 points older than 31 days are aggregate-only).

trigger: a staged rollout: version A on 900 of 1,000 devices with 90 crashes, version B on 100 with 50; over the fleet population B reads better while per exposed device it is five times worse
classification_rationale: Verification 7 and the first-release text promise a per-version comparison with rates, but the only version-level exposure is the sampled application series (off by default, top-N), usage has no version, and the fleet weights cannot separate applications
summary: Run against the real scoring code: with 100,000 crashes on every device the application sub-score only reaches 88 under the default preset, so shared presets cannot rank or band an application. unhappy-path (UP-3) independently reported the exposure gap.

trigger: any unexpected shutdown or blue screen: the operating system writes the record during the next boot, the observer subscribes to future events only, and observations raised while the stream is down are dropped
classification_rationale: 'The first release collects nothing new' is unproven for the blue-screen, power-loss and dirty-shutdown rates; #1351 (blind spot) was closed by documenting the limit and the manual states capture is forward-only
summary: Verified by the orchestrator: dex_observer subscribes with EvtSubscribeToFutureEvents, emit_guardian_event drops when the link is down (durable buffering is deferred), and the manual says events written before the agent armed are not back-filled.

trigger: the first implementing PR builds the score or the view in the server with no ruling to cite against ADR-1005's interpretation-in-the-engine boundary
classification_rationale: ADR-1005 Decision 2 classes domain scoring baked into code as engine territory and treats the in-server DEX dashboards as strangler targets; the ADR cited ADR-1005 only for the twin rule
summary: No policy floor: ADR narrative is not a floor source and 3008 amends neither ADR-1005 nor ADR-0017.

trigger: the consolidated view ships and the App Performance, Apps and Performance pages disappear; or the boot-family weighting changes values served by the existing health routes
classification_rationale: 'Existing API routes keep working' was incomplete: ADR-1005 Decision 7 requires a deprecation cycle with notice for any dashboard surface a customer depends on, and a semantic change to served values is a change in meaning
summary: Also raised by architect (the notice duty).

trigger: an implementer reads D2 as 'no new work' for a hardware or usage series, or retains central history without recording the departure
classification_rationale: D2 omitted that the series is one application-only chain and that hardware has no retained series; ADR-0016 section 7 says the server holds current state only, with the application series as an uncited precedent; the usage description named the wrong recorder
summary: Also raised by consistency-auditor (the central-history exception is uncited).

trigger: MCP twins deferred 'within the programme' with an issue and no date
classification_rationale: D11 promised recorded exceptions with a tracking issue; the architecture-contract ledger requires an issue and a revisit-by date, and 'within the programme' is unbounded
summary: Compatible with ADR-1005's ledger, which requires no date; the date makes the deferral bounded.

trigger: a reader applies Terminology to 'per application ... not joined to the version' and 'application first, then version'
classification_rationale: Terminology defined Application as image plus version while the body used application for the image and 'application version' for the scored subject; 'neither carries' had three antecedents
summary: Also raised by consistency-auditor (internal contradiction).

trigger: a reader meets 'Hub', 'Hardware cohort' and 'Reporting population' already defined in the DEX manual and the repository glossary
classification_rationale: 'Hub' is the Overview in the manual; the glossary defines Cohort (from operator tags, never from inventory) and Reporting population, and the repository's vocabulary rule says to reuse them; the open question about taking the model from inventory contradicted the glossary
summary: Also raised by architect (hand-off) and enterprise-readiness (hub name).

trigger: a reader applies 'observations behind it' to a series figure, or reads the heartbeat route in D2 with no definition
classification_rationale: Observation means signals only, yet D3 and V1 decomposed every figure into observations; the heartbeat value and 'platform' were undefined
summary: Also raised by consistency-auditor (the third channel is in neither Terminology nor the Summary).

trigger: a reader meets 'within days' and 'It misses the date' long after 2026-10-06; D6 justifies Windows-first by landing in days while Consequences say the first release collects nothing new
classification_rationale: Relative time in a durable document, no antecedent for 'the date', and an internal rationale mismatch in D6
summary: Also raised by consistency-auditor.

trigger: a reader takes 'An aggregate read does not.' as no forensic permission, no audit, or both
classification_rationale: V9 did not say whether new aggregates are audited; the existing rule audits reads that name devices and leaves aggregates that name none unaudited on success
summary: Also raised by security-guardian (nit).

trigger: an implementer asks how the ADR is verified for D1, D2, D4, D8 or D10, or which of 'dash' and 'not collected' wins
classification_rationale: Verification had no item for several decisions, precedence between the dash and not-collected states was unstated, and 'lights the figure' was untestable
summary: Also raised by consistency-auditor (D2, D8, D10 missing).

trigger: a reader checks 'there is no directory integration' against the capability map (Entra/AD user and group sync mapped to roles)
classification_rationale: The product has a directory sync; what is true is that device groups are not drawn from a directory
summary: Also raised by docs-writer (hand-off to architect).

trigger: a reader checks 'a catalogue that has not landed' against the shipped software catalogue
classification_rationale: A software catalogue and inventory page ship; what is missing is a record of where each package installs, so an executable cannot be tied to its package
summary: Also raised by docs-writer (hand-off to architect).

trigger: a reader finds capability-map 32.7 still saying scoring is deliberately not implemented after the ADR merges
classification_rationale: The amends text paraphrased the section's evidence-not-scores rationale as 'no opaque or sentiment-based score' and the map was left inconsistent; the sibling ADR-3006 pull request adds an amendment-pending note to each amended document
summary: Also raised by compliance-officer (N2), consistency-auditor and docs-writer (T4). docs-writer judged leaving the map unedited acceptable.

trigger: the ADR merges as proposed with 'Binding on merge'; the acceptance convention says a reviewed merge carries accepted
classification_rationale: ADR-3002 and ADR-3003 merged as proposed and the open ADR-3006 pull request uses the same pair, so the author's precedent runs the other way; as proposed, the ADR's requirements are not a policy-floor source
summary: Also raised by compliance-officer, docs-writer and consistency-auditor. Author's call.

trigger: a packaged application (empty version on a crash) whose performance row resolves a file version, or two builds with the same four-part number
classification_rationale: An exact match splits one application into two, drops build suffixes, and makes 'the version before it' ambiguous after a rollback; the Risks row claimed D4 answers the split
summary: Also raised by unhappy-path (UP-11).

trigger: a fleet-wide bad deploy: agents cap each signal type per hour and drop the overflow uncounted
classification_rationale: Per-1,000-device-day rates in a storm are lower bounds; the ADR did not say so
summary: Also raised by happy-path.

trigger: a family or platform nobody reports deducts nothing; signal counts from every operating system are divided by the Windows devices online
classification_rationale: Pre-existing behaviour of the shipped composite; the ADR's 'describe its Windows part' residual was wrong for it, and the new score must not copy it. Reporter marked it conditional on the new score copying the rule
summary: A note for the implementing work, recorded because the ADR's residual text was inaccurate.

trigger: one blue screen surfaces as three observation types with no boot key; merging by device and time alone hides a boot loop as one event
classification_rationale: The ADR gave the principle 'an event counts once' without saying that two failures on two boots are two
summary: Reporter marked it a roadmap note with a conditional derived band.

trigger: a device whose usage sync is skipped keeps the last figure on the server; a per-hour rate pairs a window-length numerator with a trailing thirty-day denominator
classification_rationale: The residual said a skipped sync 'reports nothing', which is wrong for usage (replace-on-sync with no expiry); the rate window mismatch was unstated
summary: Reporter marked it conditional on implementation. Usage forward-only and thirty-day bounded was also raised by enterprise-readiness.

trigger: a sparsely tagged estate: the untagged residual is the largest 'model' and tag values fragment below the floor
classification_rationale: Cohorts below the floor and devices with no model tag appear as a count and an untagged residual, so hardware comparison is thin until tags are populated
summary: Also raised by enterprise-readiness (pilot sees '(untagged)' unless the tag question is decided).

trigger: one crash-looping device dominates per-device-day rates and the mean time between failures
classification_rationale: A score or rate driven by one device's event volume misleads; the existing composite weighs breadth first and the ADR did not say the new score must
summary: Agent hourly caps bound it but do not remove it.

trigger: a reader takes the Summary as the full list of what the ADR decides
classification_rationale: The Summary's six points omitted D4, D7 and D9, and D9 is the only permission change

trigger: a reader meets an unexpanded term, a duplicated related entry, inconsistent names for one thing, or sentence fragments posed as questions
classification_rationale: 'DEX' never expanded; related repeated builds-on; 'on-request plugin action' versus 'operator-requested read'; open questions were fragments

summary: Fixed in 5b083e831: D5 scopes the direction to figures this capability adds and cites #2659; Accepted residuals gains the fail-soft entry (#2659, #4909); Context gaps and What changes in the product list it.

Fixed in 5b083e831: D5 defines the population as the devices that contributed in the period, shows how many in-scope devices are not in it, and says a connected device whose source is off, skipped or disabled counts as quiet until a coverage signal exists; residuals name the observer-disabled and skipped-sync cases; Summary and Risks updated.

Fixed in 5b083e831: D9 names the reader population and says it supersedes the forensic-only restriction for aggregates; amends names the authorization model and permission documents; Consequences adds the upgrade note and the wider-reader bullet.

Fixed in 5b083e831: D9 first rule requires published figures arranged so a withheld figure cannot be recovered by subtraction (fleet against groups, parent against child, cohort against cohort); D5 states both reasons for the floor; Verification 10.

Fixed in 5b083e831: D9 second rule: usage is published only along dimensions a reader cannot redefine (the fleet, the management groups, fixed attributes); usage by tag cohort stays at the forensic permission; Verification 15.

Fixed in 5b083e831: D5 last bullet and D9 third and fourth rules: a read naming devices is admit-then-filter and audited, not floored; a confined operator is refused an aggregate until per-caller slicing (#5090); service-scoped tokens denied; D11 carries the same denials; Verification 14 and 15.

Fixed in 5b083e831: D3 and Verification 3 scope listing to while the observations or series points are kept, up to the read limit, with retained daily values and an aged-out notice beyond; a summary keeps its reporting population; retention open question widened.

Fixed in 5b083e831: D7 gains capture at agent start and a hold for observations raised before the agent is connected, labelled lower bounds until shown on a live host; Context, gaps, Consequences, Risks, residuals and Verification 12 follow.

Fixed in 5b083e831: D1 second paragraph places the view and score as read models on the existing DEX surface, built API-first, not deepening core coupling, and records the boundary question for the maintainer in Open questions.

Fixed in 5b083e831: D1 adds the deprecation-cycle duty with notice and redirects; Consequences says routes and tools keep working and keep their meaning; Verification 1; boot-weighting open question notes a change in meaning.

Fixed in 5b083e831: D2 reworded (observation, a daily source beside the series, or a heartbeat value; no new transport); D8 records the departure from ADR-0016 section 7; Context names the on-device history as the recorder and lists hardware as having no retained series.
Fixed in 5b083e831: D11 and Verification 17 require a tracking issue and a revisit-by date.
Fixed in 5b083e831: Terminology: Application is the image name, Application version is image plus canonical version; D4 and other uses follow; 'none of those data' replaces 'neither'.

Fixed in 5b083e831: Terminology reuses the glossary for cohort and reporting population; the new view is the consolidated view; D4 and the open question now keep cohorts tag-derived and ask how the tag is populated.
Fixed in 5b083e831: Terminology defines Heartbeat value and Platform; D3 and Verification 3 say observations or series points.
Fixed in 5b083e831: Position says 'within days of that date'; D6 and its rejection speak of the customer's timeline.
Fixed in 5b083e831: Verification 14 states two explicit clauses: aggregate needs the DEX permission only and names no device; a read that names devices is audited and not floored.
Fixed in 5b083e831: Verification extended to 17 items covering D1 to D11; precedence stated in D5 and Verification 7; Verification 8 made testable.
Fixed in 5b083e831: D8 says this ADR does not draw groups from a directory.
Fixed in 5b083e831: D4 refers to the software inventory and states the real blocker (install location is not recorded); rejection reworded.
Fixed in 5b083e831: amends restated as a change of position; capability-map 32.7 carries an amendment-pending note in the ADR-3006 format.
Rejected: Inapplicable by the author's precedent (ADR-3002, ADR-3003, the ADR-3006 pull request); status kept as proposed and surfaced to the author at the push go/no-go.
Fixed in 5b083e831: Accepted residuals names the packaged-application split, the dropped suffixes and rollback ambiguity.
Fixed in 5b083e831: Accepted residuals: agents cap records per type each hour and drop the overflow, so a storm's count is a lower bound.
Fixed in 5b083e831: Context gap bullet states the composite's behaviour; D5 defines the population per source and 'not collected'; Accepted residuals reworded to rates.

Fixed in 5b083e831: D7: one failure of one boot is one event however many records the platform writes, and two failures on two boots are two; rejection names merging by device and time alone; Verification 12.

Fixed in 5b083e831: Residual says a skipped usage sync leaves the last figure to age unnoticed; usage is forward-only and bounded to the retained window; the window for a per-hour rate is an open question.
Fixed in 5b083e831: Accepted residuals names the effect; the model-tag population question is open and no longer contradicts the glossary.
Fixed in 5b083e831: D3: deductions weigh how many devices are affected before how many events any one device raised.
Fixed in 5b083e831: Summary lists eight points including identity, boot and stop events, and the usage permission change.
Fixed in 5b083e831: DEX expanded once; related no longer repeats builds-on; operator-requested read used throughout; open questions rewritten as questions.

trigger: a tag writer who also holds the DEX permission retags one device across the boundary of two dynamic management groups of at least ten devices each, or writes a service tag so that a service group is created and filled from tags; the two usage sums then differ by that device's usage
classification_rationale: D9 rule 2 listed management groups among the dimensions a reader cannot redefine; a dynamic group is an expression over tags and a tag write creates and fills a service group, so a tag writer can redefine both
summary: Architect, security-guardian and consistency-auditor each found the allow-list too permissive. Static groups change only under the management-group write permission and qualify; dynamic and tag-created groups do not. Derived LOW through E6 (docs only, nothing ships); the same text built as worded would derive I1 with E2.

trigger: a reader or implementer relies on 'fails closed, as the existing drill-downs do' and 'denied, as on every DEX read' when only the REST drill-downs fail closed and the identified drills confine a service-scoped token rather than deny it
classification_rationale: D9 rules 3 and 4 stated current behaviour broader than the code
summary: The dashboard and MCP forms of the existing drills set-and-proceed when the audit record cannot be written; service-scoped tokens are denied on aggregates and confined on drills. Also raised by consistency-auditor for rule 3.

trigger: a roadmap author reads the forward-only capture limit as an accepted decision because the cited issue 'was closed on that basis'
classification_rationale: #1351 was closed as not planned on 2026-07-14 with the comment that it was folded into #2163; #2163 is open and scopes a bookmark and catch-up read
summary: The manual's statement that capture is forward-only is true; the closure reason was inferred from the issue state alone. Verified with gh by the orchestrator.

trigger: an implementer reads 'devices known to have run that version' as a census; the series records only the top consumers, so exposure is a selected subset and a rate over it is biased
classification_rationale: The glossary's resource-significant qualifier is load-bearing (the series is top-N, not a census); the first fix round dropped it
summary: CONTEXT.md defines the term and the series store's header states the top-N scope.

trigger: a reader finds the authorization model still stating that usage is reachable only through the forensic surface after the ADR merges, or a section 7 departure recorded only in D8
classification_rationale: The open ADR-3006 pull request puts an amendment-pending note on every document it amends; the first fix round bannered one of three
summary: Also raised by consistency-auditor.

trigger: the delivery plan lands the catch-up read and the hold as a collector or queue private to DEX, deepening coupling that ADR-0021 and ADR-1005 direct away from
classification_rationale: D7 added new collection and buffering without naming the detection architecture it must be reconciled with
summary: No floor: D7 mandates no implementation.

trigger: a reader applies D3's 'devices in the cohort' and D5's 'devices that contributed' to one figure, and connected non-contributors counted as quiet contradict 'contributed'
classification_rationale: Terminology dropped 'reporting' from the glossary's cohort definition and defined the population only as contributors, while D5 counts connected quiet devices in it
summary: Observations are events, not values, so 'contributed' needs a definition for them.

trigger: a reader meets 'an application is identified by its image and version' beside a Terminology entry that defines an application as the image
classification_rationale: The Summary and the D4 heading used 'application' for the image-plus-version identity, and several places spoke of an application's score where the version was meant
summary: Recurrence of an earlier wording finding after the first fix round.

trigger: a reader takes 'a device whose observer is disabled cannot be told from a quiet one' as true; the heartbeat reports the observer's arm state and a fleet gauge counts disarmed observers
classification_rationale: The first fix round listed the observer-disabled case among the devices that cannot be told apart
summary: The arm state is reported on the heartbeat today; only the rates ignore it.

trigger: two sets that differ by one device are compared in the shipped group and tag-cohort resource trends, which publish a mean and a count above the floor
classification_rationale: D9's subtraction rule and Verification 10 are stricter than the shipped trends and the ADR did not say so
summary: The same figures per device are already readable at the same permission through the drill-down that names devices, so nothing is lost.

trigger: a reader takes the ADR as saying ADR-1005 leaves scoring's classification undecided, when its tiebreaker already reads domain scoring baked into code as interpretation
classification_rationale: Framing: ADR-1005 reserves arbitration to the maintainer but states its reading
summary: Framing only, not a falsehood.

trigger: a reader meets 'needs new collection' for the package link when the agent already collects the install location and the field is reserved, 'cohort floor' beside the glossary's 'statistical floor', 'not collected' saying reports where D5 says collects, and 'exposure', 'connected' and 'in scope' used without definition
classification_rationale: Small imprecisions left by the first fix round
summary: Also raised by consistency-auditor.

trigger: an open question about taking the model from the hardware inventory reads as reopening what D4 and the glossary exclude
classification_rationale: The question did not say that the tag stays operator-declared

trigger: an implementing change builds the usage drill on the list-read gate, which does not apply the forensic floor with access control off, and opens the drill to any authenticated session at the default configuration
classification_rationale: An implementation constraint for the follow-on work, not a defect in this ADR's text; D9 already keeps a usage drill that names devices at the forensic permission
summary: Recorded for the delivery plan's acceptance criteria for the usage read.

trigger: a reader follows the authorization model's statement that #2744 closes without a code change, while the issue is open and tracks focus time
classification_rationale: Pre-existing statement in a document this change touches; the ADR treats #2744 as the live focus-time decision
summary: After merge, #2744 should be narrowed to focus time (it also lists launches and per-application resource use, both shipped), at which point the sentence is restated.

Fixed in 4fed43fe3: D9's second rule publishes usage only along dimensions no reader can change without the forensic permission (the fleet, fixed attributes, static groups) and excludes tag cohorts and tag-defined or tag-created groups; Verification 14 and 15 follow; departments become an open question.

Fixed in 4fed43fe3: D9 rule 3 is scoped to reads the capability adds and states that only the REST forms of the existing drill-downs fail closed; rule 4 says 'as every DEX aggregate read denies it today'.

Fixed in 4fed43fe3: D7 says the build is reconciled with the Spark architecture (ADR-0021) rather than a collector or queue private to DEX; ADR-0021 added to related.
